data.exact_reserve_text: The net underwriting loss of GBP 36,223k includes the anticipated impact of the recent announcement from the Ministry of Justice, reducing the statutory discount rate applied to certain UK personal injury claims (referred to as Ogden tables) to -0.75%. This impact primarily arose from sub-Syndicate 566's casualty treaty account. During the year the syndicate entered into a significant transaction with a third party organisation, whereby, in return for a reinsurance premium, the syndicate benefits from 100% reinsurance of certain long tail outstanding claims on 2014 and prior underwriting years. This policy removes reserve uncertainty applicable to the reinsured claims, and is due to be followed by legal transfer of the underlying claims to the reinsurer.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports effectively flat prior-year reserve development at year-end (no material net PYD identified in the claims development table). The 2016 result included an adverse impact from the Ministry of Justice's Ogden discount rate change that primarily affected sub-syndicate 566 casualty treaty exposures, and the syndicate also entered into a 100% reinsurance transaction covering certain long-tail 2014-and-prior outstanding claims which removed reserve uncertainty for those reinsured items.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (PYD) figure was provided in the notes. A net claims development triangle (NET amounts) was available and yields a net PYD of zero; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is reported as 0.0 (NET basis). Gross PYD could not be identified explicitly and may be affected by the 100% reinsurance transaction of 2014-and-prior long-tail claims which removes uncertainty and could distort comparisons.
